title: Crypto builtins and precompiles
why: keccak256/sha256/ripemd160/ecrecover are EVM precompiles; solang emulates or re-implements them on pallet-contracts, and ecrecover in particular has different account/curve semantics on Substrate.
hints: keccak256(abi.encodePacked(...)) vs abi.encode(...) — packed encoding edge cases.
sha256 and ripemd160 availability (solang may reject some).
ecrecover with a fixed known signature.
abi.encodePacked with mixed types (uint8, string, bytes) — a notorious source of ambiguity.
